fusions.name: Pinch Grip
fusions.desc: A grasping snap that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 20% chance of [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Closing Fist
fusions.desc: Closes a fist of force on the target for 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% of its health, and uses up every affliction on it for 50% more damage each.

fusions.name: Defused Spring
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, you gain 20% critical chance for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
